leah (AE): Customer wants a Hosted POC but insists: no EU/APAC egress or subprocessors for that tenant. Failover only to US regions. Can we do tenant-level geo exclusion?

tom (SE): Yes we can implement tenant denylist for regions and preferred US-only failover. Need ops to confirm telemetry/subproc implications.

ops-ira: We can create a tenant profile that disables non-US integrations and blocks placement to eu/asia regions. Must validate subprocessor inventory; if any vendor only has non-US deployments we have to disable that integration for the tenant. Estimate 3 business days to validate + 2 days to canary.

sec-frank: If they require KMS and logs never leave US, we must provision tenant-scoped keys in US and disable cross-region backups. Also may need a subprocessor addendum. Legal review adds ~7 biz days.

infra-zoe: Model artifact replication is normally multi-region; for POC we can pin artifacts to US buckets and block replication for the tenant. Cold-starts from non-US traffic will be slower. Cost uplift estimate: ~10% unit cost.

tom (SE): Quick config example to show the customer:

```
tenant: corp-avalon
geo_policy: US_ONLY
allowed_regions: [us-east1, us-west1]
telemetry_integration: disabled
model_storage: US_BUCKETS_ONLY
kms: tenant-us-keys
```

leah (AE): Perfect. Can someone draft a 1-page SOW bullet (timeline + estimated surcharge + blockers) I can share with procurement today?

ops-ira: I'll draft timeline + ops checklist. Tom add the tech caveats. Sec-frank add contract bullets. Expect draft in 24 hours.

ci-bot: [ci] Created branch refs/geo-exclude/2965432100 and started pipeline.

leah (AE): Thanks all, will update customer that we're proceeding with validation.
